name: Wolf's Gravestone
passiveDesc: Increases ATK by 20/25/30/35/40%. On hit, attacks against opponents with less than 30% HP increase all party members' ATK by 40/50/60/70/80% for 12s. Can only occur once every 30s.

modifiers.label: All party members' ATK after hitting an opponent below 30% HP, including wearer
